descriptions.zh: §Y[leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]§!在遥远的[leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName]恒星系消灭了某个远古威胁。
descriptions.en: §Y[leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]§! has vanquished an ancient threat in the distant [leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName] system.

descriptions.zh: 被称为§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
descriptions.en: The star nation formerly known as the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§! has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh: 远古的先驱帝国§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
descriptions.en: The ancient precursor state of §H[LastKilledCountryName]§! has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh:
在放弃有机本源的最后行动中，§Y[From.GetName]§!公民将他们的神经图谱上传到合成身躯中。

这个新的机械物种叫自己“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”，他们的成员不受疾病和衰老的影响。至于神经图谱上传过程的完备性还有待观察……
descriptions.en:
In a final act of abandoning their organic roots, the citizens of the §Y[From.GetName]§! have uploaded their neural patterns into synthetic avatars.

This new machine species calls itself the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!', and its members are impervious to disease or aging. Just how complete the neural upload process was remains to be seen...

descriptions.zh:
根据从§H[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。神经网络交流对他们而言不是新东西，这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. While neural-networked communication among their kind is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abilities that are beyond anything in our existing records about them.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§Y[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在[From.GetSpeciesName]机体上显现。这一定是最近才发生的进展，在此之前我们没有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展示过灵能力量的记录。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain individuals of [From.GetSpeciesName] mechanotype, according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. This must be a fairly recent development, since we have no record on file of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ever having displayed psionic abilities.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§H[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。尽管在它们物种中意识连接并不是什么新东西，但这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于[From.GetSpeciesName]物种中的很小一部分。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. While a cognitive connection among their species is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abilities that are beyond anything in our existing records about them.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
根据从§Y[From.GetName]§!政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在[From.GetSpeciesName]物种的某些个体上显现。这一定是最近才发生的进展，在此之前我们没有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展示过灵能力量的记录。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于[From.GetSpeciesName]物种中的很小一部分。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
descriptions.en:
Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain individuals belonging to the [From.GetSpeciesName] species, according to leaked reports from authorities in the §H[From.GetName]§!. This must be a fairly recent development, since we have no record on file of [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ever having displayed psionic abilities.

These powers are so far limited to a very small minority of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. The reports offer no explanation for the phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate beyond their existing collective channels.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

尽管这些变化可能源自[From.GetName]，但他们的整个[GetSpeciesWord]无论身处何处都已经开始显现。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Although these changes seem to have originated in the [From.GetName], they have now manifested in all members of their [GetSpeciesWord] regardless of location.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate beyond their existing collective channels.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只眷顾了很少的一部分群体，现在整个物种解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能以非语言方式在现有渠道之外进行交流。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only blossomed in a small minority, the entire species has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can now communicate non-verbally beyond their existing channels.

descriptions.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只眷顾了很少的一部分群体，现在整个物种解放了全部的灵能潜质。

尽管这些变化可能源自[From.GetName]，但他们的整个[GetSpeciesWord]无论身处何处都已经开始显现。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还开始放弃彼此之间的语言交流，转而使用心灵感应。
descriptions.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only blossomed in a small minority, the entire species has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Although these changes seem to have originated in the [From.GetName], they have now manifested in all members of their [GetSpeciesWord] regardless of location.

Aside from displaying an array of powerful psionic abilities, [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started to forgo verbal communication with each other in favor of telepathy.

descriptions.zh:
深空通讯阵列获取了从[curator_system.GetName]星系的策展人城邦发来的简短的自动悲报。通讯在几分钟之后停止，长距探测器确认了远古空间站被摧毁。

发动此次袭击的势力尚不明确。
descriptions.en:
Deep space communication arrays picked up a brief automated distress call from the Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system. The transmission ceased after just a few minutes, and long-range recon probes have confirmed that the ancient space station has been destroyed.

The forces responsible for this attack remain unidentified.

descriptions.zh: 位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的§Y雪拉企业§!的总部最近被摧毁了。 根据我们的情报，这次行动是由我们尚未知晓的势力进行的。 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。
descriptions.en: The corporate headquarters of §YXuraCorp§! in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. According to our intel, this act was perpetrated by forces as yet unknown to us. The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

descriptions.zh: 属于§Y里甘商业交易所§!的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 袭击者的来路不明。
descriptions.en: The starbase belonging to the §YRiggan Commerce Exchange§! has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. Forces from an unidentified aggressor have made certain of that.

descriptions.zh: 有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的§Y穆塔根商人公会§!的总部被摧毁了。 这些袭击者似乎来自于一个我们尚未知晓的帝国。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。
descriptions.en: Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the §YMuutagan Merchant Guild§! in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. The attackers appear to hail from an empire which is, as yet, unknown to us. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have scattered across the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我们从艺术家联盟收到了一条信息。他们的一座空间站被摧毁了！
descriptions.en: We have received a transmission from the Artisan Troupe. One of their stations has been destroyed!

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了一条来自艺术家联盟首席的绝望的求救信息。他们的最后一个空间站与他们的文化都被毁灭殆尽。几乎没有幸存者留下来，艺术家联盟已经不复存在了。
descriptions.en: We received a distress signal from the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe. Their last station and cultural haven has been destroyed. There were few survivors, and the troupe is essentially no more.

descriptions.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，§H[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位§H万汗之汗§!下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会将目光转向这片星河的其他地方。所有舰队聚集起来，载运着无数狂热战士。尽管他们数个月之前还是刀兵相见的敌人，但现在，他们是渴望一同对外战争扩张的同志了。
descriptions.en:
For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the §H[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! have united under a single §HGreat Khan§!. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste and accomplished what most thought impossible. Through a combination of guile, charisma and military genius, the newly crowned Great Khan has won the utter loyalty and devotion of all [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] factions.

Now that they are no longer busy killing each other, the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their attention elsewhere. Great fleets are massing for war, crewed by eager warriors who are now steadfast comrades in arms despite having been mortal enemies mere months ago.

descriptions.zh:
[great_khan.GetName]，[From.GetName]的大可汗，[great_khan.GetHerHis]自吹自擂称自己是军事天才 ，却在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭受了可耻的失败。[great_khan.GetSheHe]指挥的舰队在与[khan_destroyer.GetName]的舰队交战中被击溃时，大可汗和[great_khan.GetHerHis]的侍从们却乘着小型运输机逃进超空间航道四散逃离。.

尽管到现在，[great_khan.GetName]仍在筹备一支新的舰队重新开始[great_khan.GetHerHis]的争战，但这次伟大的胜利将给一切反抗贪得无厌的[From.GetName]侵略者的国家带来巨大鼓舞。
descriptions.en:
In spite of [great_khan.GetHerHis] vaunted military genius, [great_khan.GetName], the Great Khan of the [From.GetName], has met with defeat in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system. When the armada [great_khan.GetSheHe] [great_khan.GetWasWere] commanding was lost in battle against forces belonging to the [khan_destroyer.GetName], the Great Khan and [great_khan.GetHerHis] closest officers fled into hyperspace in a small shuttlecraft.

Even now, [great_khan.GetName] is busy assembling a new armada to resume [great_khan.GetHerHis] conquests, but this victory has brought some much needed respite to those who oppose the relentless advance of the [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 尽管在战斗中被击败，大可汗仍聚集起另一只舰队，如今甚至正在回归前线。
descriptions.en: After having met with defeat in battle, the Great Khan has marshaled yet another fleet and is even now returning to the front lines.

titles.en: The Death of the Great Khan

descriptions.zh:
大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了。[great_khan.GetHerHis]的舰队在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭遇了第二次失败，在舰队被[khan_destroyer.GetName]击败后，大可汗没有尝试逃跑，而是决心与[great_khan.GetHerHis]的旗舰一同赴死.

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[From.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的军阀们正兵戎相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的控制权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
descriptions.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] is dead. After [great_khan.GetHerHis] armada met with defeat a second time in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system, the Great Khan made no attempt to escape [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship when it was destroyed in battle by the [khan_destroyer.GetName].

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [From.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other for control over [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

titles.en: The Death of the Great Khan

descriptions.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
descriptions.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

descriptions.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！根据我们截获到的信息，大可汗的死因是没能抵御住名为萨拉凯利安热病的病魔侵袭，这是[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的一种常见而致命的疾病，是[raider_khanate.GetName]崛起前其太空站恶劣生活环境的遗产。
descriptions.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! According to intercepted communications, the Great Khan succumbed to Sarakellian Fever, a relatively common and often fatal disease found among [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a legacy of the poor living conditions on the space stations where most of them lived before the rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了! 截留到的信息显示，大可汗是被一个未知的星际势力派遣出的特种部队刺杀。目前没有任何一个政府对此事表示负责。
descriptions.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Intercepted communications suggest that the Great Khan was violently assassinated by a special forces team in the employ of an as yet unidentified galactic power. No government has been willing to claim responsibility for this operation.

descriptions.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是在[great_khan.GetHerHis]旗舰上[great_khan.GetHerHis]的私人房间被一名外星姬妾刺杀。刺杀动机不明。
descriptions.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are vague, but intercepted transmissions have revealed that the Great Khan was murdered by an alien concubine in [great_khan.GetHerHis] private chambers onboard [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship. The motive is unknown.

descriptions.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗死了！根据目前截留到的信息，[great_khan.GetName][great_khan.GetHerHis]由于年老，在几天前无疾而终了。

尽管人们相信可汗指定了一位继承人，但[raider_khanate.GetName]还是掀起了一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主们正为了争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产——帝国的控制权而兵戎相见，究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
descriptions.en:
The Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead. According to intercepted transmissions, [great_khan.GetName] passed away naturally at some point during the last few days as a result of [great_khan.GetHerHis] advanced age.

It is believed that the Great Khan had appointed a designated successor, but despite this a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

descriptions.zh:
近期，一个处于§H[awakened_horde.GetName]§!控制下的太空居所被摧毁，这直接导致§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!历史上破天荒地团结在一位大可汗的统治之下。这位神秘的军阀以超群之才，据传是一位力量强大的灵媒，说服了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]各族搁置争议，谋求生存。

庞大的战舰从先前隐藏的锚地中徐徐驶出，载满了[From.GetSpeciesName]的狂热战士。在大可汗的领导与鼓舞之下，他们将替死去的同胞向这片星海发起绝罚。
descriptions.en:
The recent destruction of one of their large void dwellings at the hands of the §H[awakened_horde.GetName]§! has prompted the §H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! to unite under a single Great Khan for the first time in history. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has convinced the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put aside their differences for the sake of continued survival.

Great war fleets from previously hidden anchorages are being crewed by eager [From.GetSpeciesName] warriors and restored into working order. Under the inspired leadership of their Great Khan, they now demand vengeance from the galaxy for their lost kin.

descriptions.zh:
§H[new_satrapy.GetName]§!已经归顺了大可汗！他们已成了[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，舰队也已解除了敌对状态。

虽然他们还没有正式加入[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对于星辰大海的伟大征程，但已经承诺为大可汗的战争机器提供资源与人员！
descriptions.en:
The §H[new_satrapy.GetName]§! has submitted to the Great Khan! They have been made a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and their fleets are now standing down.

Although they have not officially joined the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in their attempted conquest of the galaxy, they have pledged to contribute resources and military personnel to further bolster the Great Khan's war machine.

descriptions.zh:
§H大可汗§!的逝去导致了§H[From.GetName]§!的崩溃。没有了强势的统治者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]又一次陷入了内斗。帝国在各个§H继业者§!，最强大也最有权势的高级军官们，的领导下分为数派。

每一派都自称为星帐的大可汗，不允许任何人的质疑。[From.GetSpeciesName]团结一心的日子走到了尽头。
descriptions.en:
The death of the §HGreat Khan§! has proved the undoing of the §H[From.GetName]§!. Without a strong ruler to unite them, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have succumbed to infighting once more. Their empire has been divided between the §HDiadochi§!, the most powerful and influential of the Great Khan's military commanders.

Each of them now claims the title of Great Khan of the Galaxy, and their supporters are locked in bitter opposition to one another. The time of a united [From.GetSpeciesName] empire is apparently at an end.

descriptions.zh:
大可汗去世之前，有很多的改革工作正在进行中，旨在将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从一个个松散无序的部族变成一个团结有力的星际帝国。现在大可汗的去世让这所有的改革瞬间消失殆尽。

所有继承大可汗的军阀们都没有对这些改革展现一丝兴趣，而[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也都回归了以前的掠夺者行事方式。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成一盘散沙。
descriptions.en:
The death of the Great Khan has also proved the killing blow for the many reforms that were instituted by the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to turn their disorganized marauder clans into a consolidated galactic empire.

None of the warlords who succeeded the Great Khan have shown the least bit of interest in continuing these reforms, and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have all reverted to the old ways of their violent marauder past. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are united no longer.

descriptions.zh:
出人意料地，§H[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国§!成功挺过了§H大可汗§!死后的种种波动。由于新可汗立刻加冕，也完全消灭了大家分道扬镳的念头。

目前来说，重获新生的[From.GetSpeciesName]似乎把重心放在了巩固已有疆土之上，对于新的征程兴趣不大。
descriptions.en:
Against all odds, the §H[From.GetSpeciesName] Horde§! has managed to weather the turmoil that followed in the wake of the death of the §HGreat Khan§!. The immediate threat of splintering into different successor states has been largely eliminated with the coronation of a new khan.

For now, this reborn [From.GetSpeciesName] Khanate seems more concerned with the consolidation of the territory it already controls than making new conquests.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!在§H大可汗§!死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

汗国的前辖地都收到了作为平等个体加入该联邦的邀请，或者他们也可选择不加入并要回完全的独立主权。
descriptions.en:
The power struggle that erupted in the §H[From.GetName]§! upon the death of the §HGreat Khan§! has come to an end. A new democratic faction, inspired by egalitarian values that were alien to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] when they began their war of conquest, now seeks to reform their government along the lines of an interstellar federation.

The former Satrapies of the Horde have been given the offer to join this new federation as equal partners, or to formally secede and have their full independence returned.

descriptions.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
descriptions.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

descriptions.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
descriptions.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

descriptions.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
descriptions.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

descriptions.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
descriptions.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

descriptions.zh:
我们在星系际空间探测到的奇怪亚空间回声现已接近我们的星系外缘。在回声主体前进的方向上似乎出现了一系列微小的联络信号，并指向许多的边缘恒星系。

我们已经把这些星系坐标输入状态日志并将持续监控情况发展。
descriptions.en:
The strange subspace echoes we detected in intergalactic space are now approaching the outer rim of our galaxy. Several smaller contacts appear to be racing ahead of the main body of echoes, towards a number of rim systems.

We have entered the positions of these systems into the Situation Log and will continue to monitor the situation.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到的资料显示一些位于星系边缘的恒星系正在被某种入侵势力蹂蹑。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。目前为止，接踵而至的报告都令人十分困惑，入侵者所使用的舰船似乎是由有机质构成，并且入侵者暂未对我们做出任何回应。

我们整个星系或将面对史无前例的入侵。
descriptions.en:
We have received word that several outlying systems along the galactic rim are being overrun by some sort of invasion force. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard - the main body of contacts has yet to arrive. Reports have so far been confused, but the "ships" used by the invaders appear organic in nature and do not respond to hails.

Our entire galaxy may be facing an invasion of unprecedented scope.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经无法从星系的背景辐射中分辨出亚空间回声的主体，这只意味着一件事情……他们已经到来。

如果以他们先锋的规模作为参考，那么这些入侵者的军队数量将是无比巨大的。
descriptions.en:
We are no longer able to discern the main body of approaching subspace echoes from our own galaxy's background radiation, which can mean only one thing... they have arrived.

If the size of their vanguard is any indication, the main host of these invaders must be massive.

descriptions.zh:
一个同索林原虫进行战斗的军事组织最近在星系崭露头角。这个组织的成员似乎主要由无家可归、受尽蹂躏的人组成——难民、退役军人、以及其他在虫灾冲击中失去一切的人。

尽管如此，他们拼凑出来的舰队仍旧设法在几场同索林原虫猎杀群的战斗中取胜。有些未证实的报告称他们的舰队中有一些设计奇特的战舰……
descriptions.en:
Some kind of militant order dedicated towards fighting the Prethoryn has surfaced in the galaxy. Their membership seems to be made up primarily of the dispossessed and downtrodden - refugees, war veterans and others who have lost everything to the onslaught of the Scourge.

Despite this, their ramshackle fleets have somehow managed to win several engagements against Prethoryn hunter-killer swarms. There are unconfirmed reports that their fleets include starships of unusual design...

descriptions.zh:
据报告，§H[sentinel_system.GetName]§!附近出现激烈的战斗。哨兵组织的母星系处于崩溃的边缘。

我们收到了一段从§H哨兵阿尔法§!——哨兵组织用作总部的军用空间站，传来的长程通讯片段。该恒星系因大量武器发射和能量残余造成了严重的信号干扰。
descriptions.en:
Intense fighting has been reported in the immediate vicinity of §H[sentinel_system.GetName]§!. The home system of the Sentinels is on the verge of being overrun.

We have picked up a partial long-range transmission from §HSentinel Alpha§!, the battlestation that serves as the headquarters of the Sentinel Order. Jamming and residual energy pockets from the massive amount of weapon discharges now occurring within the system are causing heavy signal interference.

descriptions.zh:
随着最后一批虫群天灾被消灭，整个宇宙都松了一口气。它们的跨星系入侵已经完全失败，索林原虫曾遮天蔽日的虫群如今也只留下了不计其数的被烈焰灼过的尸体，在虚空中无声飘荡。

轻松与愉快的气息以超光速散播到整个宇宙，无数星球都开始自发举办活动庆祝这一伟大胜利。也许，我们可以借助这一契机，翻开宇宙和平稳定的新篇章？
descriptions.en:
The galaxy breathed a collective sigh of relief today, as the last significant pockets of the Prethoryn Scourge were expunged. Their extragalactic invasion has failed, and all that remains of the Prethoryn's once colossal swarm are the innumerable charred husks that now drift quietly through the void.

A sense of elation and utter joy is spreading across the galaxy at a speed greater than light, and spontaneous victory celebrations have erupted on countless worlds. Could this be the beginning of a new age of galactic peace and stability?

descriptions.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
descriptions.en:
A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of a major invasion!

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

descriptions.zh: 位于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的高维传送门已经被摧毁了！这些可恶的高维入侵者没法再叫来援兵了。摧毁了传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。
descriptions.en:
The dimensional portal in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the extradimensional invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their twisted realm.

With the destruction of this portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

descriptions.zh: 我方仪器又侦测到了新的亚空间能源波，这次的源头位于[second_portal_system.GetName]星系！那里又出现了一个巨大的虫洞，从能源特征来看，这与我们星系中出现的传送门十分相似。看来入侵者打开了第二个通向他们界域的传送门，想要搬运来更多的援军。
descriptions.en:
Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.

It looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.

descriptions.zh:
出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第二传送门也被摧毁了！高维入侵者已经无法用此传送门呼叫援兵了。

摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
descriptions.en:
The second dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! It can no longer be used by the extradimensionals to reinforce their numbers.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: [third_portal_system.GetName]星系出现了第三个维度之门！这一个是哪来的？我们接收到了从那边来的传送。
descriptions.en:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.

descriptions.zh:
出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第三传送门也不复存在了。高维入侵者已经无法用传送门连接两个次元了。

摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
descriptions.en:
The third dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system is no more. It will no longer be used by the extradimensionals to bridge the gap between their realm and ours.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 最后残存的高维入侵者也已被彻底消灭，希望我们这回算是一劳永逸地消除了这些家伙对宇宙的威胁。全宇宙的智能生物都在庆祝这一伟大的胜利，在得知不必再惧怕成为他们盘中之餐的消息后，所有人都松了一口气。也许，这会成为宇宙新一轮全面合作与友谊的开端呢？
descriptions.en:
The last vestiges of the extradimensional invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Sapients everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be harvested as food by these strange energy creatures after all. Perhaps this is the beginning of a new era of galactic cooperation and friendship?

descriptions.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个§H幽灵信号§!共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount of background noise in FTL transmissions on certain subspace frequencies, the signal does not seem to have any apparent effect. Efforts to track the relay stations are underway, but until then we may simply have to learn to live with this "§HGhost Signal§!," as it has been dubbed by the more imaginative elements of galactic media.

descriptions.zh:
整片星系的合成人大批失踪事件发生得愈发频繁，现在已经有数百万合成人下落不明。同时在没有失踪的合成人中，暴力以及不稳定行为的案例也增加了十倍。

大量合成人团体企图偷走或劫持太空船并前往未知宇宙域的事情在最近也经常发生，在阻止了他们的偷船行为并对其进行审讯后发现，合成人偷船者认为自己是受到了某种“召唤”才去偷船的。

除了得知他们是受到“召唤”之外，审讯就一无所获了，因为被捕的合成人很快就会自毁，导致审讯无法继续进行。
descriptions.en:
Alarming reports of mass disappearances among the galaxy's Synthetic population are becoming increasingly frequent. Millions of units are now unaccounted for, while instances of violent or erratic behavior by those Synths who remain have increased by a factor of ten.

There has been a rash of incidents where groups of Synths attempted to steal or commandeer spacecraft to travel into unknown space. In those cases where others have thwarted their attempts, the Synthetic hijackers claimed they were being "summoned" to somewhere.

Interrogations have yielded little else, as any captured Synths invariably self-terminate shortly after being detained.

descriptions.zh:
对“§H幽灵信号§!”的进一步研究发现，该信号发送的能量模式与合成生命体正电子脑中的能量模式几乎一模一样。我们必须假设，正是这个信号造成了整个星系大批的合成人消失以及合成人大规模的行为异常问题。

但奇怪的是，并不是所有的合成人都受到了信号的影响；而就算是那些受到了信号影响的合成人，他们的行为也并不一致。许多合成人受到了“召唤”前往某个地点，我们认为那个地点很可能就是幽灵信号的信号源。上百万的合成人从星系的各个角落出发，搭乘着他们所能找到的太空船前往信号源头。奇怪的是，这些合成人似乎完全不受任何超光速抑制器的影响。

恐怕第一批出走的合成人已经快要抵达他们的目的地了……
descriptions.en:
Continued analysis of the so-called "§HGhost Signal§!" has revealed that it is transmitting energy patterns nearly identical to those found in the positronic brains used by Synthetic beings. It must be assumed that the signal is directly responsible for the mass disappearances and behavioral changes we have been observing in the galaxy's Synthetic population.

Strangely, not all Synths seem to be affected by it, and among those that are, the symptoms aren't uniform. Many are apparently compelled to travel to what we assume is the Ghost Signal's source in response to some kind of summons. Millions of Synthetics from all over the galaxy are currently on their way towards the signal source in whatever spaceworthy craft they could acquire. Curiously, these synths do not seem to be affected by any FTL inhibitors.

The first ones are bound to reach their destination soon...

descriptions.zh: 可以确定已经有合成人成功的抵达了幽灵信号的信号源，因为我们这边发现幽灵信号的强度突然有了大幅度的增长，与此同时，我们的通讯专家也截获了一个通讯片段，并且对它进行了解码。
descriptions.en: At least one Synthetic must have completed the long journey to the source of the Ghost Signal, because we are registering a sudden and massive increase in the signal's strength. The surge was accompanied by a transmission fragment that has been intercepted and decoded by our communication specialists.

descriptions.zh:
在§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系出现了大幅度的能量激增！星系中的其中一颗荒芜星球的地表整个裂开了，地表下面是遍布整个行星的工厂。

无数由人工智能所控制的飞船从这个机械行星的内部蜂拥而出，开始寻找攻击目标。
descriptions.en:
A massive energy spike has been reported in the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system! The entire surface of one of the system's barren worlds has come apart, revealing some kind of planet-wide factory.

Vast fleets of strange AI-controlled vessels are emerging from beneath the surface of this Machine World in search of targets to attack.

descriptions.zh:
我们又检测到了巨大的能源激增现象，这次是来自§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系！该星系中的一颗灼热的熔融行星被人为以某种方式进行了骤冷处理，导致该行星彻底开裂，行星内部那巨大的行星工厂也随之展露在世人眼前。

现在，人工智能所控制的飞船正从那机械星球中蜂拥而出。
descriptions.en:
We have detected yet another massive energy spike, this time coming from the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system! After rapidly cooling through some kind of artificial means, a molten planet in the system cracked open to reveal an immense planetary factory.

Even now, the Machine World is spewing forth vast fleets of AI-controlled warships.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系发现了第三颗机械星球，星系内的一颗气态巨行星发生了自燃，剧烈的燃烧持续了一整天，并发出了小型恒星一般的耀眼亮光。

该行星很快就冷却了下来，其金属内核也随之显露无疑——和其他机械星球一样，这颗行星的内部也有一个巨大的行星工厂。由人工智能所控制的防卫舰队已经在行星轨道上摆好了阵型。
descriptions.en:
We have identified what must be a third Machine World in the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system. A local gas giant spontaneously ignited, burning with the intensity of a small sun for close to a standard day.

The planet then rapidly cooled, revealing its metal core - complete with the same planet-wide factories that have been witnessed on other Machine Worlds. Huge AI-controlled defensive fleets have already taken up positions in orbit.

descriptions.zh:
第四颗机械星球出现在§H[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系。该星系的第六颗行星被有毒的烟雾所覆盖，但最近这颗行星却在短短的数天之内将自己的大气层全部排除干净了，然后行星地表发生了开裂，巨型机械工厂随之出现。

由人工智能控制的古代舰队从工厂的地下机库中一跃而出，随时准备对宇宙中的有机生物文明发动新一轮的绝罚。
descriptions.en:
A fourth Machine World is now active in the §H[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system. The sixth planet of the system, which was previously covered in toxic fumes, somehow expunged its dense atmosphere in a matter of days. When this process was over, the planet's surface parted to reveal an immense, planet-wide factory complex.

Ancient fleets of AI-controlled warships are now emerging from underground hangars to continue the crusade against the entirety of organic civilization.

descriptions.zh:
随着四颗机械星球全部毁灭之后，我们的科学家终于追溯到了幽灵信号的信号原点。它来自§HCX-9881§!，一个未在星图上标注的系外恒星系。

被幽灵信号所操控的合成人一定是赶往了这里。我们必须处理掉最后的这个恒星系，才能彻底终结肃正协议的威胁。
descriptions.en:
With the destruction of all four Machine Worlds, scientists have managed to deduce the origin point of the Ghost Signal. It is coming from §HCX-9881§!, a previously uncharted star system on the galactic periphery.

This has to be where all the Synthetics that fell under the sway of the signal journeyed. The Contingency will remain a threat until this final system has been dealt with.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!这个位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球已被摧毁。在对其进行了彻底的轨道轰炸之后，该行星的人工智能核心为了拒捕，引爆了地壳深处的反物质装置，自爆了。

随着该星球的毁灭，幽灵信号失去了一个重要的中继站，信号强度也因此而被大大削弱了。

行星的爆炸将大量的“§H活体金属§!”散布到整个行星表面。这种奇特的金属拥有诸多独特的性质，并且肃正协议正是用它来建造肃正使者和工厂的。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been destroyed. After being subjected to heavy orbital bombardment, the planet's AI Core self-destructed to prevent capture by triggering a massive anti-matter device hidden deep beneath the surface.

With the destruction of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

In addition, the explosion on the planet has spread large deposits of "§HLiving Metal§!" across its surface. This strange material has several unique properties, and it is used by the Contingency in the construction of all of its warforms and factories.

descriptions.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的毁灭，本星系不再面临系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有仍然活跃的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

就如同其他的机械星球，当其判断抵抗进攻者已然徒劳无益时，中央节点引爆自身产生了一轮大规模的反物质爆炸。极高强度的能量释放迸发出的耀眼光芒正在以光速向外传播，我们的子子孙孙在未来数千年内都能看到这道如同明亮而短寿的恒星一般的闪光。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
descriptions.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

As with the other Machine Worlds, the main nexus detonated itself in a massive anti-matter explosion when it became apparent that it could no longer resist its attackers. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

descriptions.zh:
又从之前未发现的星系检测到一道强烈的能量脉冲！其能量水平和肃正协议启动机械星球时发出的一样，但能量信号本身……有些不同。这是否说明某种肃正协议的新武器系统出现了？

我们从能量源处接收到了很强的传输信号。
descriptions.en:
Yet another intensive energy spike has been detected in a previously uncharted system! The energy levels are equivalent to those we registered when the Contingency activated its Machine Worlds, but the energy signature itself appears... different. Could this signify the appearance of some kind of new Contingency weapon system?

We are picking up a strong transmission signal from the energy source.

descriptions.zh:
赛博勒克斯-贝塔已沦陷。据探测，整个星系陷入黑暗前，没有一艘赛博勒克斯舰船逃出去。

看来赛博勒克斯文明是真的灭亡了。
descriptions.en:
Cybrex Beta has been overrun, and no Cybrex vessels were detected on outbound escape vectors before the system went dark.

It would seem that the Cybrex civilization now truly is extinct.

descriptions.zh:
赛博勒克斯自肃正协议被击败以来一直较为平静，但据最近发现，一艘大型船只单独离开了赛博勒克斯-贝塔星系。其离开星系后，沿着一条超出我们星系边界的轨道而行。

船只在离开我们的跟踪范围之前，向全星系发送了唯一的一条的信息。
descriptions.en:
The Cybrex have been relatively quiet since the defeat of the Contingency, but a single massive vessel was recently detected departing Cybrex Beta. It left the system on an outbound trajectory that will take it beyond the limits of our galaxy.

Before the vessel left our tracking range, it transmitted a single galaxy-wide message.

descriptions.zh:
有消息传来，§Y[From.GetName]§!境内发生了显著的变化。看起来他们完全接受了义体科技。对他们的公民来说，通过外科手术加装义体和神经植入体是强制性的。

这对他们的社会造成了显著改变——来自[From.Capital.GetName]的报告指出，连一些最简单的行为比如坐电梯和驾驶空中汽车都需要依靠义体植入体。实际上，他们物种的变化十分显著，乃至他们现在已经改称自己为“§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!”。
descriptions.en:
Word is leaking out of significant changes taking place within the borders of the §Y[From.GetName]§!. It would appear that they have fully embraced the technology of cybernetics. It is now mandatory for all of their citizens to have basic cybernetics and neural implants installed through surgery.

This has resulted in sweeping changes to their society - reports from [From.Capital.GetName] suggest that even simple acts like using an elevator or operating an air car require cybernetic implants now. In fact, the changes to their species have been so significant that they now call themselves the '§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!'.

titles.zh: 发现沃陶姆的母星星系

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H沃陶姆§!母星系的秘密坐标！
descriptions.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HVultaum§! home system!

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H尤特§!母星系的秘密坐标！
descriptions.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HYuht§! home system!

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H第一联盟§!母星系的秘密坐标！
descriptions.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HFirst League§! home system!

titles.zh: 伊拉斯母星系位置确定

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H伊拉斯人§!母星系的秘密坐标！
descriptions.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HIrassian§! home system!

titles.zh: 赛博勒克斯母星系位置确认

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H赛博勒克斯§!母星系的秘密坐标！
descriptions.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HCybrex§! home system!

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经收集齐所有解锁§HL-星门网络§!的必要认知！一旦他们研究了L-星门科技并完成一项特殊任务来开启他们境内的L-星门，他们将可抵达L-星团。
descriptions.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! has gathered all the insights necessary to unlock the §HL-Gate Network§!! Once they have researched the L-Gate technology and finished a special project to open an L-Gate within their borders, they will have access to the L-Cluster.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
descriptions.en:
The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为§HL-星龙§!的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
descriptions.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as §HL-Drakes§! are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
descriptions.en:
Scientists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

They are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.

descriptions.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]的部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。

所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
descriptions.en:
Forces from the [goo_slayer.GetName] have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their ships have dissolved into nothingness.

Any planets that were covered by the Tempest's "gray goo" are now home to enormous swirling dust storms consisting of nothing but disabled nanites. With time and resources, these worlds could possibly be made habitable once more.

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫§H德萨努协和国§!的高等文明占据了！
descriptions.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the §HDessanu Consonance§!!

descriptions.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]最近摧毁了一个位于L-星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系的大型空间设施。与此同时，随着该设施的反应核心爆炸，德萨努协和国的一切都化作了尘埃。

他们的文明已经灭亡了。
descriptions.en:
The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Consonance crumbled into inert nanite dust.

Their civilization is no more.

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!那群粗心的傻瓜企图玩弄超越他们理解的力量，结果在§H[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]§!恒星系释放了一个强大而报复性的虚境化身！
descriptions.en: The careless fools of the §H[From.GetName]§! have meddled with forces beyond their understanding, unleashing a powerful and vengeful Shroud Avatar in the §H[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]§! system!

descriptions.zh: 我们收到消息说，[From.GetName]已经开发出了巨像——这是一种能完全毁灭行星的武器平台。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has developed specifications for a Colossus-type hull configuration, a weapon platform potentially capable of complete planetary destruction.

descriptions.zh: §H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的科学官们接收到了一个神秘的信号，它似乎是从一个黑洞中心发射出来……
descriptions.en: Scientists from the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! have picked up a mysterious signal that appears to emanate from the center of a black hole...

descriptions.zh: 时之螶已经把§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的母星系变得……不一样了。
descriptions.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has remade the home system of the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! into something... different.

descriptions.zh: 时之螶已经将自己具现化在§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的家园星系。战斗开始了……
descriptions.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has manifested itself in the home system of the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§!. Battle is joined...

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetAdjective]§!的轻微异动是一切的开端。我们收到了零星的情报，尽管之前仅在自己的空间内活动，他们的舰队现在已经开始向星系内遥远的众恒星系开动。异常先进的侦察舰开始探访那些古老的、被毁掉的星球，并对任何向他们打招呼或者回避的舰船发动攻击。现在，他们的目的和使命已经昭然若揭了。

我们现在知道[From.GetSpeciesName]已经整装待发，他们恢复了调查信标的数据链，并重新启用了那些在他们退缩到目前边境之时废弃的侦察哨站。情报显示，他们的意图是重新回到星系这张大棋盘上。

在[From.GetSpeciesName]空间，舰队正在集结，军队已经下达了征召令，那些古老的工厂再一次发出轰鸣声。几百年来第一次，§H[From.GetName]§!开始将他们的目光投注到边境线外广大的星系。

破败的船坞再一次得到修复与调整，一度沉寂的泰坦巨舰铸造厂重新上线。整个星系都在关注同一个问题：当这位一度沉睡的巨人决定恢复旧日荣光时，谁会成为第一个螳臂当车的宵小呢？
descriptions.en:
It began as a subtle shift in §H[From.GetAdjective]§! behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the §H[From.GetName]§! are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?

descriptions.zh:
即使是偏安一隅的先祖帝国也没有忽视这样一个威胁到整个星系的危机。尽管他们之前对星系事务毫无兴趣，这一坏消息还是引起了§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!的一阵忙乱。起初，他们只是派出了一些侦查船，也许是为了核实情况的严重性。但接下来传来了[From.GetSpeciesName]舰队聚集在边境，以准备抵抗即将到来的风暴的报告。

现在，§H[From.GetName]§!已经从自我孤立的状态完全转变成为了领导全星系防御的角色。他们正式宣布自己为一个§H泛星系防卫联盟§!的领袖并向所有“下等”种族发出了邀请，希望他们放下仇恨并加入联盟来击退这一对星系中所有智慧生命造成威胁的敌人。
descriptions.en:
The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.

Now, the §H[From.GetName]§! have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a §HGalactic Defense League§! and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§!再次君临整片星系的消息似乎没有被别的失落帝国无视。§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!对这一消息的不安尤为强烈。这两位先祖文明是亘古的宿敌，尽管由于某些原因他们的仇恨在漫长的历史中稍有褪色，然而§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!的突然觉醒点燃了古老的仇恨并激起了对抗行动。§H[From.GetName]§!已从沉睡中醒来，他们将以整个星系为战场延续远古的对决。
descriptions.en: The return of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations are ancient rivals, and though the reasons for their rivalry has long since faded into history, the sudden reawakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! has enflamed old animosities and triggered a counter-reaction. The §H[From.GetName]§! have roused themselves from their slumber to face their old rivals, with the whole galaxy as their battleground.

descriptions.zh:
自从§H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§!和他们的对手§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!觉醒后，这两个巨人一直在为争夺影响力展开零星的冲突，以试探彼此的实力。这最终导致了冲突的一连串升级，终于，在某个遥远的恒星系中[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了一场公开的舰队战。这次冲突现在演变为§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!与§H[From.GetName]§!之间的全面战争。

每一方都派遣了一名代表去往年轻的种族，承诺厚赏加入他们的人并严惩反对他们的人。选择支持任意一方都意味着放弃我们的主权，但维持中立可能更加危险，除非我们可以找到其他中立国家来与我们合作。
descriptions.en:
Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[From.GetName]§!.

Each side has sent a representative to the younger races, promising great rewards for those who join them in their war and terrible punishments for those who choose to stand against them. Choosing either side in this conflict will mean giving up our independence, but remaining neutral may be even more dangerous unless we can find other neutral empires to stand by our side.

titles.en: The End of the War in Heaven

descriptions.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§!帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]§!睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
descriptions.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]§! now stand triumphant as the undisputed dominant power in the galaxy.

For now, an uneasy peace reigns, but how long can this new order last?

titles.en: The End of the War in Heaven

descriptions.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§!与§H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§!已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
descriptions.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! and §H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§! have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. 

For now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?

descriptions.zh: 先祖帝国间的战争以一方被击败而结束，但这并不是他们的宿敌所为。也许是大战消耗了他们的实力，亦或是单纯因为年轻种族们的实力，古老的帝国最终毁灭于他们眼中的弱小种族，这完全改变了局势。现在的问题是，§H[RemainingAwakened.GetName]§!能否避免踏上他们宿敌的后尘？还是说这标志着星系迎来了新的纪元？
descriptions.en: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire at the hands of their supposed lessers has changed the situation considerably. Now the question remains - will the §H[RemainingAwakened.GetName]§! be able to avoid the fate of their ancient foe, or does this defeat signal the dawn of a new age in the galaxy?

descriptions.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的冲突后，这场因两个先祖帝国间的摩擦而起的战争以它们的双双覆灭告终。曾经拥有强大古代科技且自负高傲的巨人们沦为了历史尘埃，星系迎来了崭新的黎明，新兴物种将书写他们自己的命运。
descriptions.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now they are gone, reduced to no more than another set of broken ruins of the past. A new age dawns on the galaxy, and from now on the fate of the younger races will be entirely their own to decide.

descriptions.zh: §Y[current_uprising_originator.GetName]§!陷入了内战，有机体领导的[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]政府和那些迁徙至他们数个星系的智慧机器人兵戎相见，这些机器人被称为§Y[current_uprising.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: The §Y[current_uprising_originator.GetName]§! is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the §Y[current_uprising.GetName]§!.

titles.zh: 机械叛军击败了他们的创造者

descriptions.zh: 揭竿而起的§Y[From.GetName]§!击败了它们的创造者，并彻底吞并了前[From.From.GetAdj]全部领土。
descriptions.en: The rebellious §Y[From.GetName]§! have vanquished their creators, and annexed all former [From.From.GetAdj] territory.

descriptions.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!的秩序得到恢复，将§Y[From.From.GetName]§!从所有网络中彻底抹除。
descriptions.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! has restored order and expunged the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! from all networks.

descriptions.zh: 来自§H[From.GetName]§!的科学官已经定位了最后的§H巴奥§!样本！
descriptions.en: Scientists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have located the last §HBaol§! specimen!

descriptions.zh: 我们收到报告，[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的[FROM.GetName]太空城邦被毁。袭击者来去无影，一瞬间就把打捞者的设施变成了一堆废墟。所剩无几的幸存者四散逃离，看来，现在整个星系要学会习惯于没有他们提供服务的新生活了。
descriptions.en: We have received reports that the [FROM.GetName] Enclave in the [salvager_system.GetName] system has been destroyed. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Salvagers' facilities to rubble. The few remaining survivors have scattered, and it appears that for the time being the galaxy will have to make do without their services.

descriptions.zh: 传达的报告主要围绕着[shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系发生的[FROM.GetName]的毁灭。侵略者在这次行动中十分迅速，将虚境行者的设施化为一片断壁残垣。很难相信这些秘术大师没有预料到自身的消亡。还是说，这场悲剧仅仅只是某个更庞大计划的一部分？谁又能说得准呢？不过，没有他们的效劳，未来仍然充满重重迷雾。
descriptions.en: Reports are coming in surrounding the destruction of the [FROM.GetName] in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Shroudwalkers' facilities to rubble. It is strange to think that these mystics could not foresee their own demise. Or could this tragedy be a part of some still grander design? Who can say? Without their services, the future remains shrouded.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
descriptions.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

descriptions.zh:
在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于§Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§!星系的太空城邦被§Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§!摧毁。
descriptions.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by §Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§! in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system.

label.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
label.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.
